name: billingconductor
description: Billing Conductor is a fully managed service that you can use to customize a pro forma version of your billing data each month, to accurately show or chargeback your end customers.

subcommands.name: associate-accounts
subcommands.description: Connects an array of account IDs in a consolidated billing family to a predefined billing group.

subcommands.name: associate-pricing-rules
subcommands.description: Connects an array of PricingRuleArns to a defined PricingPlan.

subcommands.name: batch-associate-resources-to-custom-line-item
subcommands.description: Associates a batch of resources to a percentage custom line item.

subcommands.name: batch-disassociate-resources-from-custom-line-item
subcommands.description: Disassociates a batch of resources from a percentage custom line item.

subcommands.name: create-billing-group
subcommands.description: Creates a billing group that resembles a consolidated billing family that Amazon Web Services charges, based off of the predefined pricing plan computation.

subcommands.name: create-custom-line-item
subcommands.description: Creates a custom line item that can be used to create a one-time fixed charge that can be applied to a single billing group for the current or previous billing period.

subcommands.name: create-pricing-plan
subcommands.description: Creates a pricing plan that is used for computing Amazon Web Services charges for billing groups.

subcommands.name: create-pricing-rule
subcommands.description: Creates a pricing rule can be associated to a pricing plan, or a set of pricing plans.

subcommands.name: delete-billing-group
subcommands.description: Deletes a billing group.

subcommands.name: delete-custom-line-item
subcommands.description: Deletes the custom line item identified by the given ARN in the current, or previous billing period.

subcommands.name: delete-pricing-plan
subcommands.description: Deletes a pricing plan.

subcommands.name: delete-pricing-rule
subcommands.description: Deletes the pricing rule that's identified by the input Amazon Resource Name (ARN).

subcommands.name: disassociate-accounts
subcommands.description: Removes the specified list of account IDs from the given billing group.

subcommands.name: disassociate-pricing-rules
subcommands.description: Disassociates a list of pricing rules from a pricing plan.

subcommands.name: get-billing-group-cost-report
subcommands.description: Retrieves the margin summary report, which includes the Amazon Web Services cost and charged amount (pro forma cost) by Amazon Web Services service for a specific billing group.

subcommands.name: list-account-associations
subcommands.description: This is a paginated call to list linked accounts that are linked to the payer account for the specified time period.

subcommands.name: list-billing-group-cost-reports
subcommands.description: A paginated call to retrieve a summary report of actual Amazon Web Services charges and the calculated Amazon Web Services charges based on the associated pricing plan of a billing group.

subcommands.name: list-billing-groups
subcommands.description: A paginated call to retrieve a list of billing groups for the given billing period.

subcommands.name: list-custom-line-item-versions
subcommands.description: A paginated call to get a list of all custom line item versions.

subcommands.name: list-custom-line-items
subcommands.description: A paginated call to get a list of all custom line items (FFLIs) for the given billing period.

subcommands.name: list-pricing-plans
subcommands.description: A paginated call to get pricing plans for the given billing period.

subcommands.name: list-pricing-plans-associated-with-pricing-rule
subcommands.description: A list of the pricing plans that are associated with a pricing rule.

subcommands.name: list-pricing-rules
subcommands.description: Describes a pricing rule that can be associated to a pricing plan, or set of pricing plans.

subcommands.name: list-pricing-rules-associated-to-pricing-plan
subcommands.description: Lists the pricing rules that are associated with a pricing plan.

subcommands.name: list-resources-associated-to-custom-line-item
subcommands.description: List the resources that are associated to a custom line item.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: A list the tags for a resource.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Associates the specified tags to a resource with the specified resourceArn.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Deletes specified tags from a resource.

subcommands.name: update-billing-group
subcommands.description: This updates an existing billing group.

subcommands.name: update-custom-line-item
subcommands.description: Update an existing custom line item in the current or previous billing period.

subcommands.name: update-pricing-plan
subcommands.description: This updates an existing pricing plan.

subcommands.name: update-pricing-rule
subcommands.description: Updates an existing pricing rule.
